adn.resume_en: 0% show 3D relief/bevel (mean relief 0.4/10), 0% carry contour/rim glow (mean glow 0/10), 100% sit on a dark background and 0% on a gradient/atmospheric one, 0% of outlined marks use a thick (usually white) contour, 0% add particles/sparkles. Mean saturation 0/10, mean brightness 1.8/10, mean complexity 1.6/10. Dominant materials: none measured. Dominant palette: #000000, #FFFFFF.

composition: Centered 1:1 ratio silhouette or geometric emblem occupying 50% to 70% of the canvas area.
Strictly symmetrical or dynamic 45-degree angled orientations.
High-contrast negative space cutouts within solid circular or rounded square frames.
Thick, uniform stroke weights and clean vector paths with no fine details.
typographie: No external text or typography allowed outside the central emblem.
Single-letter integrations must be stylized as negative space cutouts within a solid geometric shape.
Letterforms must use thick, uniform geometric curves and sharp straight cuts.
lumiere: 100% flat 2D illumination with zero gradients, shadows, or highlights.
Pure emissive white values against absolute black to maximize contrast.
No simulated light sources or directional shading.
etalonnage: Strictly binary color palette: Pure White (#FFFFFF) and Pitch Black (#000000).
Zero saturation, zero midtones, and zero grayscale transitions.
effets: Clean, razor-sharp vector edges with no blur, glow, or anti-aliasing artifacts.
Optional flat 2D perspective extrusion shadow to simulate blocky 3D depth.
logo: Emblem must function as a standalone, self-contained icon centered on a square canvas.
interdits: Do not use gradients, drop shadows, or outer glows.
Avoid thin lines, complex textures, or intricate organic details.
No multi-colored elements or off-black/off-white hues.
Never include external text, labels, or decorative borders.
